description: 한국수력원자력(주)_원자력발전소 실시간 온배수 현황 [nuclear facilities and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). “원자력발전소 실시간 온배수현황” API는 한국수력원자력㈜이 제공하는 공공데이터 서비스입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수력원자력(주). Its tags are 원자력발전소, 원전, 온배수, 실시간 온배수 현황, 원전 현황. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
